answer: Before first payout, the holder links the title deed of a small timber plot they own, its deed number and a boundary reading signed with the account key. Two verifiers check the deed against the land registry within a week, confirming name and edges. A deed already linked to another account, or a forged boundary, closes both accounts. An honest holder links land they already own in a minute, while a thousand fakes would need a thousand separate plots, each with its own deed, and no fable can stand in for a title on the registry ledge.
